name: FavouraFetch Design System
instructions_for_ai: Treat this file as the single source of truth for the FavouraFetch front end. Apply every section. Never change functionality or the existing API_BASE_URL value. If anything here conflicts with working behavior, keep the working behavior and tell the user.

brand.hero_support_line: Paste a link, pick a quality, save it.
brand.logo: Use the attached logo image in the navbar, footer and as favicon. Logo has a black background and fits the dark theme.

pattern.cta: Link input is the main focus above the fold; 'Get Started' navbar button scrolls to it
sections_in_order: Hero with link input and results area

style.name: Modern dark glass
style.card_effect: semi-transparent card with light backdrop blur

rules: Long text and URLs must wrap, never clip
Keep line length comfortable on phones

effects.hover: lift 2px on buttons and cards, glow in the item's own color
effects.reduced_motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion and disable non-essential animation

navbar.right: gradient 'Get Started' button that scrolls to the input
navbar.mobile: collapse links into a menu icon

supported_sites.card_style: glass card, icon 28 to 32px on the left, site name beside it, glow in icon color on hover
supported_sites.disclaimer: Brand names and logos belong to their respective owners. FavouraFetch is not affiliated with these services.

tools.title: Video Downloader
tools.description: Paste a link and download the video

tools.title: MP4 to MP3
tools.description: Extract audio from a video file

tools.title: MP4 to GIF
tools.description: Turn a video clip into a GIF

tools.title: YouTube Transcript
tools.description: Get the text of a video

tools_rules: Cards with status coming_soon show a 'Coming soon' badge and are not clickable.

steps: Paste it and tap Get Video

trust_rules: Do NOT add star ratings, review counts, security-scan badges or any claim that is not true.

footer.legal_pages: Terms and Privacy open as a simple modal or page with short placeholder text the owner can edit later
footer.usage_notice: Only download content you own or have permission to save. Respect creators' rights and each platform's terms.

functionality_to_preserve.api_base_url: Keep the existing API_BASE_URL value exactly as it is. Never replace it with a placeholder.
features: Get Video flow: POST {API_BASE_URL}/api/info with { url }
Download history of the last 5 links in localStorage with a Clear button
Error states with a Retry button, showing the message from { error }
Downloads start by navigating to the downloadUrl, never by fetching the file in JavaScript

playlist.title: string
playlist.total: number of videos in the playlist
playlist.formats: same shape as video formats (ZIP downloads)

functionality_to_preserve.locked_formats: Show greyed out with a lock icon, disabled, with the note text underneath. Never trigger a download for them.
functionality_to_preserve.playlist_ui: Playlist card with title, thumbnail, 'count of total videos', total duration; list of entries each with a 'Get this video' button that runs that entry url through the normal flow; then ZIP download buttons.

waiting_messages.file: Preparing your file. Please keep this page open.
waiting_messages.zip: Preparing your playlist. This can take several minutes, please keep this page open.

functionality_to_preserve.duration_format: h:mm:ss when over one hour, otherwise mm:ss

anti_patterns: Emojis used as icons (use SVG icons)
More than the brand gradient plus one accent color
Harsh or long animations, auto-playing motion
Long paragraphs and cluttered rows of buttons
Copying text, logos or branding from other websites
Fake ratings, reviews or security badges
pre_delivery_checklist: Every button has a clear label and cursor-pointer on clickable elements
Focus states are visible for keyboard navigation
Text, chips and badges reflow without clipping at 360px wide
Locked options are greyed out with a lock icon and note
Loading and error states look consistent
Nothing overflows horizontally on a small phone
API_BASE_URL is unchanged and the app still downloads videos
